home.conoce_jalpan: Get to Know Jalpan de Serra
home.jalpan_desc: A magical town in the Queretaro Sierra Gorda with a unique gastronomy that combines mountain traditions, ancestral flavors, and the characteristic hospitality of the region.
home.gastro_desc: Jalpan's cuisine is characterized by its unique mountain flavors, featuring fresh regional ingredients and traditional culinary techniques.
home.ingredients_desc: Products from the Sierra Gorda such as wild greens, wild mushrooms, honey, trout, and a great variety of regional aromatic herbs.
home.tradition_desc: The heritage of the Franciscan missions is reflected in traditional dishes that have been passed down from generation to generation for more than 250 years.
home.conoce_jalpan_cta: Do you want to know more about our mountain gastronomy?
home.conoce_jalpan_desc_cta: Discover the traditional recipes, local ingredients, and the history behind the dishes that make our region unique.

home.hero_tagline: Eat, explore and unwind in the heart of the Sierra Gorda.

contacto.faq_1_q: Requirements to register on the platform?
contacto.faq_1_a: Basic requirements include having a gastronomic establishment located in Jalpan de Serra, having the corresponding municipal permits, and providing complete and truthful information about your business.
contacto.faq_2_q: Is there any cost to use RestauranteWeb?
contacto.faq_2_a: No, RestauranteWeb is completely free for all establishments in Jalpan de Serra. Our goal is to promote local gastronomy at no cost to owners.
contacto.faq_3_q: Can I update my establishment's information?
contacto.faq_3_a: Yes, once your establishment is registered, you will have access to a personal panel where you can update all information, including menu, hours, photos, and contact details in real-time.
contacto.faq_4_q: How can customers find my establishment?
contacto.faq_4_a: Customers can find your establishment through a search by name, type of food, location, or by using the filters available on the home page.
